newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Sysco FY97 estimate trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sysco FY97 estimate trimmed.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it had trimmed its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Sysco Inc to $1.73 a share from $1.75 to reflect more conservative sales and inflation assumptions.
-- Rodman said Sysco's sales mix improvement is offsetting a slowdown in its real estate growth.

-- Sysco reported second quarter earnings of $0.43 a share, a 10 percent improvement on $0.39 a year earlier. Adjusting for a $0.01-per-share write-off of bad debt in connection with a restaurant customer's bankruptcy, the rise was 13 percent, Rodman said.
-- Sysco markets and distributes food and related products to the take-out foodservice industry.
